script.code:
SELECT 'cfg' AS kind, CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id, CONVERT(c.config_sequence USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS val
  FROM price_history_config c
 WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND c.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.organizationId}}' AND c.document_type = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.document_type}}' AND c.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tag' AS kind, CAST(x.id AS CHAR) AS id, x.price_tag_id AS val
  FROM customer x
 WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.needFetch}}' = 'Yes' AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.fetchFrom}}' = 'Customer' AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tag' AS kind, CAST(x.id AS CHAR) AS id, x.price_tag_id AS val
  FROM supplier_head x
 WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.needFetch}}' = 'Yes' AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.fetchFrom}}' = 'Supplier' AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY kind, LENGTH(id), id

script.code:
WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT j.item_id, j.uom_id, j.ii, j.uu
             FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.pairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (item_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[0]', uom_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[1]',
                               ii BIGINT PATH '$[0]' NULL ON ERROR, uu BIGINT PATH '$[1]' NULL ON ERROR)) j)
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(IF('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.side}}' = 'sales',
                      JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                                  'sales_unit_price', u.sales_unit_price,
                                  'sales_min_price', u.sales_min_price,
                                  'sales_max_price', u.sales_max_price,
                                  'min_sales_qty', u.min_sales_qty,
                                  'max_sales_qty', u.max_sales_qty,
                                  'mat_sales_tax_id', CAST(u.mat_sales_tax_id AS CHAR),
                                  'sales_tax_percent', u.sales_tax_percent),
                      JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                                  'purchase_unit_price', u.purchase_unit_price,
                                  'purchase_min_price', u.purchase_min_price,
                                  'purchase_max_price', u.purchase_max_price,
                                  'min_purchase_qty', u.min_purchase_qty,
                                  'max_purchase_qty', u.max_purchase_qty,
                                  'mat_purchase_tax_id', CAST(u.mat_purchase_tax_id AS CHAR),
                                  'purchase_tax_percent', u.purchase_tax_percent)))
             FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
            WHERE u.Item_id = i.id
              AND u.is_deleted = 0
              AND u.alt_uom_id IN (SELECT pp.uu FROM p pp WHERE pp.ii = i.id)
       ), '[]') AS uom_conversion_json
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.ii FROM p) sel
  JOIN item i
    ON i.id = sel.ii
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT j.item_id, j.uom_id, j.ii, j.uu
             FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.pairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (item_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[0]', uom_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[1]',
                               ii BIGINT PATH '$[0]' NULL ON ERROR, uu BIGINT PATH '$[1]' NULL ON ERROR)) j),
     h AS (SELECT 'SO' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.so_item_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN sales_order_axszx8cj_sub x ON x.item_name = p.item_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND x.so_item_uom = p.uu
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.useSO}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
       UNION ALL
       SELECT 'SQT' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.unit_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN quotation_rdywe1rx_sub x ON x.material_id = p.item_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND x.sqt_order_uom_id = p.uu
         JOIN quotation q ON x.quotation_id = q.id
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.useSQT}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND q.sqt_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
       UNION ALL
       SELECT 'PREQ' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.pr_line_unit_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN purchase_requisition_9wptilyh_sub x ON x.pr_line_material_id = p.item_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND x.pr_line_uom_id = p.uu
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.usePREQ}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
       UNION ALL
       SELECT 'PO' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.unit_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub x ON x.item_id = p.item_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND x.quantity_uom = p.uu
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.usePO}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
       UNION ALL
       SELECT 'SI' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.unit_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN sales_invoice_zt0c3x55_sub x ON x.material_id = p.ii AND x.invoice_qty_uom_id = p.uu
         JOIN sales_invoice hd ON x.sales_invoice_id = hd.id
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.useSI}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND hd.si_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
       UNION ALL
       SELECT 'PI' AS src, p.item_id, p.uom_id, x.order_unit_price AS unit_price, x.create_time, x.id
         FROM p
         JOIN purchase_invoice_xpuy7o4q_sub x ON x.material_id = p.ii AND x.quantity_uom = p.uu
         JOIN purchase_invoice hd ON x.purchase_invoice_id = hd.id
        WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.usePI}}' = 'YES'
          AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND x.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.plantIdSafe}}' AND x.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'
          AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND hd.pi_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft'))
SELECT r.src, r.item_id, r.uom_id, r.unit_price
  FROM (SELECT h.src, h.item_id, h.uom_id, h.unit_price,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.src, h.item_id, h.uom_id ORDER BY h.create_time DESC, h.id) AS rn
          FROM h) r
 WHERE r.rn = 1

script.code:
WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT j.item_id, j.uom_id, j.ii, j.uu
             FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.pairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (item_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[0]', uom_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$[1]',
                               ii BIGINT PATH '$[0]' NULL ON ERROR, uu BIGINT PATH '$[1]' NULL ON ERROR)) j)
SELECT t.item_id, t.uom_id, t.min_order_qty, t.max_order_qty, t.discount, t.discount_type, t.tax, t.tax_percent, t.unit_price, t.min_price,
       t.max_price
  FROM (SELECT p.item_id, p.uom_id, sq.sup_min_order_qty AS min_order_qty, sq.sup_max_order_qty AS max_order_qty, sq.sup_price_discount AS discount,
               sq.sup_price_discount_type AS discount_type, sq.sup_price_tax AS tax, sq.sup_price_tax_percent AS tax_percent, sq.sup_price_unit_price AS unit_price,
               sq.sup_price_min_price AS min_price, sq.sup_price_max_price AS max_price, sq.id AS rid
          FROM p
          JOIN item_qd8nxw32_sub sq ON sq.Item_id = p.ii AND sq.sup_price_uom = p.uu
          JOIN item i ON sq.Item_id = i.id
         WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.needTag}}' = 'YES' AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.fetchFrom}}' = 'Supplier' AND sq.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND sq.is_deleted = 0
           AND (sq.sup_price_tag_id = '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.tagIdSql}}' OR ('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' IS NOT NULL AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' != '' AND sq.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'))
           AND ((sq.sup_price_date_from IS NULL AND sq.sup_price_date_to IS NULL) OR (sq.sup_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sq.sup_price_date_to IS NULL)
                OR (sq.sup_price_date_from IS NULL AND sq.sup_price_date_to > CURDATE()) OR (sq.sup_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sq.sup_price_date_to > CURDATE()))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p.item_id, p.uom_id, sc.cust_min_order_qty AS min_order_qty, sc.cust_max_order_qty AS max_order_qty, sc.cust_price_discount AS discount,
               sc.cust_price_discount_type AS discount_type, sc.cust_price_tax AS tax, sc.cust_price_tax_percent AS tax_percent, sc.cust_price_unit_price AS unit_price,
               sc.cust_price_min_price AS min_price, sc.cust_price_max_price AS max_price, sc.id AS rid
          FROM p
          JOIN item_i9q0d8uj_sub sc ON sc.Item_id = p.ii AND sc.cust_price_uom = p.uu
          JOIN item i ON sc.Item_id = i.id
         WHERE '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.needTag}}' = 'YES' AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.fetchFrom}}' = 'Customer' AND sc.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.tenantId}}' AND sc.is_deleted = 0
           AND (sc.cust_price_tag_id = '{{node:code_node_UPplan.data.tagIdSql}}' OR ('{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' IS NOT NULL AND '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}' != '' AND sc.customer_id = '{{node:code_node_UPkeys.data.suppCustIdSafe}}'))
           AND ((sc.cust_price_date_from IS NULL AND sc.cust_price_date_to IS NULL) OR (sc.cust_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sc.cust_price_date_to IS NULL)
                OR (sc.cust_price_date_from IS NULL AND sc.cust_price_date_to > CURDATE()) OR (sc.cust_price_date_from < CURDATE() AND sc.cust_price_date_to > CURDATE()))) t
 ORDER BY t.item_id, t.uom_id, t.rid
